prompt: Create a highly realistic cinematic surreal photograph of a young woman appearing twice in the same scene at radically different scales. The main figure is a giant version of the woman emerging through a huge jagged hole in a cracked concrete wall behind the road, with her upper body visible, both hands gripping broken slabs of concrete on the left and right edges of the opening. She has long dark brown hair, natural makeup, warm skin, a calm confident expression, and direct eye contact. She wears a slightly loose cream button-up shirt. In the foreground, place a normal-sized full-body version of the same woman standing centered on the double yellow line of an empty cracked asphalt road, arms crossed, wearing the same cream button-up shirt tucked into high-waisted taupe trousers and white sneakers. The road recedes toward the broken wall for strong depth and scale contrast. Surround the wall opening with rough rubble, fractured stone, and visible dark void behind the giant figure. Add colorful graffiti painted on the broken concrete: exactly 9 visible decorative graffiti elements, including 3 pink hearts, 2 blue hearts, 2 yellow stars, 1 large pink paint splash, and 1 large blue paint splash, with smaller drips and splatters around them. Use golden-hour sunlight from the side, realistic shadows, detailed skin texture, sharp cracked concrete texture, cinematic color grading, vertical portrait composition, low-to-mid camera angle, 35mm lens feel, shallow-to-moderate depth of field, ultra-detailed photorealism, surreal scale illusion, no text, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一张高度写实的电影感超现实主义照片，让 一位年轻女性 以截然不同的比例同时出现在同一场景中。主体是一个巨型版本的女性，正从道路后方破裂混凝土墙上的巨大锯齿状洞口中探出，露出上半身，双手抓着洞口左右两侧破碎的混凝土板。她留着深棕色长发，妆容自然，肤色温暖，表情冷静自信，直视镜头。她穿着一件略显宽松的奶油色衬衫。在前景中，放置一个正常大小、全身版本的同一女性，她站在空旷且布满裂纹的沥青路双黄线上，双臂交叉，穿着同样的奶油色衬衫，下身搭配高腰灰褐色长裤和白色运动鞋。道路向破损的墙壁延伸，营造出强烈的深度和比例对比。墙壁洞口周围环绕着粗糙的碎石、断裂的石块，巨型人物身后是可见的深色虚空。在破碎的混凝土上添加色彩鲜艳的涂鸦：准确包含 9 个可见的装饰性涂鸦元素，包括 3 个粉色爱心、2 个蓝色爱心、2 个黄色星星、1 个巨大的粉色油漆溅痕和 1 个巨大的蓝色油漆溅痕，周围伴有细小的滴落和飞溅效果。使用侧向的黄金时刻阳光，呈现逼真的阴影、细腻的皮肤纹理、清晰的混凝土裂纹质感、电影级调色、竖构图、低至中机位视角、35mm 镜头感、浅至中等景深、超精细写实风格、超现实比例错觉，无文字，无水印。
